invented.quote: including clients who had been with me for years.
invented.why: The brief only states that the price was raised for "existing clients" and mentions events from "last year," without stating that clients had been with her for multiple years.

invented.quote: None of them left over the price.
invented.why: The brief states that two clients left last year (when they sold their salons) and that the price was raised in January, without stating whether any clients have left since the January price increase.
